candidates.event: Moonshot AI (Kimi) released the open-weight model Kimi K3.1 Pro

facts.claim: Kimi K3.1 Pro was introduced as the first model in the K3.1 series, an open-weight model with a 1-million-token context window
facts.quote: our most capable 3T-class open-weight model to date, with a 1-million-token context window

facts.claim: The model and a faster variant are available now through Kimi's products and API; full weights are due by November 4
facts.quote: The full model weights will be released by Nov 4.

facts.claim: The company reports 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2%) and just behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4%); these are the developer's own reported results
facts.quote: K3.1 Pro scores 65.7%, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2%) and narrowly behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4%)

facts.claim: The developer says it removed cyber-related data from training; vulnerability-exploit benchmark success fell from 90.5% to 81.0% versus a checkpoint without the measures
facts.quote: solves 90.5% of problems at pass@3; the final K3.1 Pro reaches 81.0%

candidates.notes: Primary source is the vendor's own announcement; benchmark figures are self-reported and must be attributed. HN 913 points.

candidates.event: Physicists trapped a single positron (antimatter particle) for a month

facts.claim: A team led by Gerald Gabrielse of Northwestern University reported in Physical Review Letters that it isolated a single positron for a month
facts.quote: This method allowed the researchers to isolate and study a solitary, lone positron for a month

facts.claim: The report was published on Wednesday in Physical Review Letters
facts.quote: The team reported its achievement on Wednesday in Physical Review Letters.

facts.claim: The goal is to measure the positron's magnetic moment and compare it to the electron's; the Standard Model predicts exactly opposite values
facts.quote: We’re looking to see if they have an exactly opposite magnetic moment,

candidates.conflicts: The lede says 'for months at a time', the body says 'for a month'.
candidates.notes: Science item rather than software; fits 'published research and measured results'. Article dated 2026-10-21; paper reported Wednesday (10-21). HN 42 points, low.

candidates.event: Canada's Bill C-22 (Lawful Access Act) is before the Senate

facts.claim: Bill C-22 has passed the House of Commons and is now before the Canadian Senate
facts.quote: has already passed the House of Commons, and is now before the Canadian Senate.

facts.claim: The bill would let the Public Safety Minister order companies to create a backdoor for law enforcement, provided it does not lead to a 'systemic insecurity'
facts.quote: allows Canada’s Minister of Public Safety to order companies to create a backdoor to their services for law enforcement

facts.claim: The bill requires services to retain metadata for up to a year
facts.quote: It also requires services to retain metadata for up to a year

candidates.notes: Source is an advocacy post (EFF) with strongly editorial framing; only the legislative status and described provisions are usable, and a second, neutral source is not in the bundle. Likely drop.
